🌍 Welcome to the WBO Tech Suite

Your Global Platform for Working by Outcomes at Roche Pharma International

Whether you're brand new to monday.com or a returning user, you're in the right place. This page is your single reference point for everything you need to navigate, contribute, and get the most out of the WBO Tech Suite.

What is the WBO Tech Suite?

Working by Outcomes (WBO) is a cornerstone element of our operating model, essential for realizing the One Pharma Strategy (OPS). By enabling greater focus and collaboration, WBO aims to minimize "energetic cost" while maximizing positive patient, societal, and business impact.

The WBO Tech Suite is the technology platform that makes this framework live and actionable. It replaces a fragmented ecosystem of Google Slides, Sheets, Trello, and Tableau with a single "one source of truth" on monday.com and Airtable for Middle East and North Africa countries. We use WBO Tech Suite to eliminate the 'energetic cost' of fragmented work. By choosing to solve once for many, we break down local silos and leverage the entire global network to find, reuse, and scale our best work.

💡 The Tech Suite is not just another tool — it's your engine for growth and global collaboration.

🌍 Middle East & North Africa Affiliates

Powered by Airtable WBO Tech Suite

Affiliates in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region operate on a dedicated instance of the WBO Tech Suite built on Airtable. This separate but fully aligned platform mirrors the same Working by Outcomes framework used across all Roche Pharma International affiliates — ensuring consistency in how outcomes, work packages, and milestones are tracked, regardless of the underlying tool.

If you are based in or working with a MENA affiliate, all your team's work package data, outcome tracking, and progress updates are centralized in the Airtable WBO Tech Suite. You can access it directly via the link below.

Open Airtable WBO Tech Suite →

How the Workspace is Organized

🏢 Regional Boards (50+ Affiliates)

Each country has its own Work Package Overview board where local teams manage their active, ongoing, and completed WPs:

  • EMEA: Germany, Greece, Poland, UK, Spain, Italy, France, Netherlands
  • APAC: Australia, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong
  • LATAM: Argentina, Colombia, CCAV
  • Africa: Ghana, Nigeria, South Africa
  • Global clusters: COMET, iNET

🏆 Outcomes

  • Short Term Outcomes (STO) — Immediate deliverables within a cycle
  • Mid Term Outcomes (MTO) — Medium-horizon strategic objectives
  • Long Term Outcomes (LTO) — Long-range strategic goals

🗄️ Repository & Workflows

Reference boards that power automations and data consistency:

  • Countries + Codes
  • Disease Area
  • Product
  • Function
  • Area
  • Workflow boards for automated routing, subitem creation, and outcome management

What's Coming Next

🔗

Platform Integration — Coming Soon

monday.com ✕ Airtable

We are actively working on a native integration between monday.com and Airtable — so that all affiliates, regardless of which platform they use, always have access to the same up-to-date data.

This integration will eliminate manual syncing, reduce duplication, and ensure that MENA affiliates on Airtable and all other regions on monday.com are always aligned — sharing one unified, real-time view of outcomes, work packages, and milestones across the entire Roche Pharma International network.

💡 Under Consideration

  • Collaboration Spaces — Dedicated areas for cross-regional project collaboration
  • Custom Reporting Builder — Create and save personalized report templates
